{{Quote|Ooh, it's a big ol' scrap. Everybody who gets all three of their bounties goes into the rage pit. One comes out.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:TH">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Huntmaster|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
The '''Grand Melee''' was an event that took place on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in [[3643 BBY]] for qualification into the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]]. An [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] won the Melee by [[Death/Legends|killing]] all of the participants. This individual would eventually go on to win the Great Hunt.<ref name="TOR:TM" />
